d:
Bihar ke bahubli neta anant sinh ek bar phir charcha men hain. is bar vajah hai unke damad ke lie laee gaee lagjari Land Rover Defender! gulab ke phulon se saji is shandar Defender ko dekhne ke lie logon ki bhir jut gaee. gari ke sath selphi lene ke lie logon men hor lag gaee.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
